description: When a Signature method fails, the framework asks four questions in order: Was the calm established? Was the method explained plainly? Was the simulation mastered? Was the patient in control? The order matters — most failures trace to the first question, not the technique. Fix the foundation before blaming the method.
key_points: Most failures trace to calm, not technique
Document every failure for the design log
how_it_works: Ask: was calm established first?
Ask: was it explained plainly?
Ask: was simulation mastered?
Fix the earliest broken link, then retry

title: Signature History: Origins of the Method
description: The Signature hygiene method began, in this telling, with a single observation: patients remembered how the visit felt longer than what was done. Every Signature invention since — calm-first, mirror-moment, layered debridement — descends from that observation. The history is kept as a design narrative so future inventors know what problem each method solved.

Future inventors learn the problems, not just solutions

title: Signature Teaching Method
description: Signature teaching uses the same ladder as Signature training: the teacher demonstrates once, guides the learner's hand once, then watches silently while the learner teaches it back. Teaching-back is the graduation — if you cannot teach it plainly, you have not mastered it. Every Signature instructor is certified by teaching, not by testing.
how_it_works: Demonstrate the method once
Guide the learner's hands once
Watch silently as they perform it
Certify when they can teach it back

Advancement requires contribution — a new method, a refined standard, a taught cohort — never just tenure.
